name: Citizenship by Direct Investment

requirements.blocker_text: Non-repatriable investment of at least US$500,000 in Bangladeshi industry.
requirements.fix_path: Invest and retain (non-repatriably) at least US$500,000 in a Bangladeshi industrial enterprise.

requirements.blocker_text: Non-repatriable transfer of at least US$1,000,000 to a recognized Bangladeshi financial institution.
requirements.fix_path: Transfer and retain (non-repatriably) at least US$1,000,000 to a recognized Bangladeshi financial institution.

evidence_required.document: Application via the Ministry of Home Affairs Online Security Clearance System (SSD portal)

sources.title: Consulate General of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Dubai -- Investment Prospects in Bangladesh: 'Citizenship by investing a minimum of US$500,000 or by transferring US$1,000,000 to any recognized financial institution (non-repatriable)'

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official consulate sourced. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE MARQUEE ROUTE: a direct citizenship-by-investment program is unusual outside the Caribbean CBI-heavy nations built elsewhere in this dataset -- Bangladesh offering one via a South Asian, non-island, non-tax-haven economy is a notable structural finding. FIGURE CONFLICT, DISCLOSED: a 2016 press report (The Daily Star, tier-4, citing a cabinet decision) states these very figures (US$500,000 investment / US$1,000,000 transfer) were themselves DOUBLED from a still-earlier baseline (US$250,000 / US$500,000) as of March 2016 -- and separately, tier-3 law-firm sourcing (legalseba.com) reports a further-doubled CURRENT figure of US$1,000,000 investment / US$2,000,000 transfer, unconfirmed at tier-1. This dataset uses the figures as they currently appear on an official government consulate page (US$500,000/US$1,000,000) rather than the higher tier-3-reported figures, consistent with this build's rule of not asserting a specific number without tier-1 backing -- but given at least one prior doubling is independently confirmed to have happened, and tier-3 sources consistently report the SAME higher figures, there is a real possibility the consulate page is simply outdated. Direct BIDA/Ministry of Home Affairs verification is recommended before relying on either figure. Both pathways result in a Dual Nationality Certificate and Smart Card NID per tier-3 sourcing (legalseba.com), not independently tier-1 confirmed. This is distinct from bd_citizenship_dual_nationality.json, which is the route for Bangladeshi-ORIGIN diaspora who acquired a foreign citizenship and want to retain/reacquire Bangladeshi nationality -- this file is for non-Bangladeshi-origin investors acquiring Bangladeshi citizenship for the first time.
